import pandas as pd
import os

files = {
    "Label": r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_label_num.csv",
    "mRNA": r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_mRNA.csv",
    "CNV": r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_CNV.csv"
}

for name, path in files.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 100)
    print(f"FILE: {name}")
    print(f"PATH: {path}")
    print("=" * 100)

    # Check whether the file exists
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("ERROR: File not found")
        continue

    # Load dataset
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    # Basic dimensions
    print(f"\nShape: {df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} columns")

    # Show all variable/column names
    print("\nVARIABLE / COLUMN NAMES:")
    for i, col in enumerate(df.columns, start=1):
        print(f"{i}. {col}")

    # First rows
    print("\nFIRST 5 ROWS:")
    display(df.head())

    # Data types
    print("\nDATA TYPES:")
    print(df.dtypes)

    # Missing values
    print("\nTOTAL MISSING VALUES:")
    print(df.isna().sum().sum())

    print("\nMISSING VALUES BY COLUMN (only columns with missing data):")
    missing = df.isna().sum()
    print(missing[missing > 0])

    # Duplicate rows
    print("\nDUPLICATED ROWS:")
    print(df.duplicated().sum())

    # First column, useful for checking sample IDs
    print("\nFIRST COLUMN NAME:")
    print(df.columns[0])

    print("\nFIRST 10 VALUES OF FIRST COLUMN:")
    print(df.iloc[:10, 0].tolist())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

label_path = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_label_num.csv"
mrna_path  = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_mRNA.csv"
cnv_path   = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\Pan-cancer_CNV.csv"

labels = pd.read_csv(label_path)
mrna = pd.read_csv(mrna_path)
cnv = pd.read_csv(cnv_path)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract sample IDs
# ---------------------------------------------------------

mrna_samples = mrna.columns[1:].tolist()
cnv_samples = cnv.columns[1:].tolist()

print("Number of labels:", len(labels))
print("Number of mRNA samples:", len(mrna_samples))
print("Number of CNV samples:", len(cnv_samples))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check exact sample alignment
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print("\nExact mRNA/CNV sample order identical:",
      mrna_samples == cnv_samples)

print("Same sample IDs regardless of order:",
      set(mrna_samples) == set(cnv_samples))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check duplicates
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print("\nDuplicate mRNA sample IDs:",
      len(mrna_samples) - len(set(mrna_samples)))

print("Duplicate CNV sample IDs:",
      len(cnv_samples) - len(set(cnv_samples)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Check unmatched samples
# ---------------------------------------------------------

only_mrna = set(mrna_samples) - set(cnv_samples)
only_cnv = set(cnv_samples) - set(mrna_samples)

print("\nSamples only in mRNA:", len(only_mrna))
print("Samples only in CNV:", len(only_cnv))

if len(only_mrna) > 0:
    print("Examples only in mRNA:", list(only_mrna)[:10])

if len(only_cnv) > 0:
    print("Examples only in CNV:", list(only_cnv)[:10])

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. TCGA patient IDs
# first 3 barcode components: TCGA-XX-XXXX
# ---------------------------------------------------------

patient_ids = ["-".join(x.split("-")[:3]) for x in mrna_samples]

print("\nNumber of unique patient IDs:", len(set(patient_ids)))
print("Number of sample IDs:", len(patient_ids))
print("Patients with more than one sample:",
      len(patient_ids) - len(set(patient_ids)))

print("\nFirst 10 sample -> patient mappings:")
for sample, patient in list(zip(mrna_samples, patient_ids))[:10]:
    print(sample, "->", patient)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Label inspection
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print("\nNumber of unique labels:")
print(labels["Label"].nunique())

print("\nLabel counts:")
print(labels["Label"].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\nLabel range:")
print(labels["Label"].min(), "to", labels["Label"].max())

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Gene identifier inspection
# ---------------------------------------------------------

mrna_genes = mrna.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)
cnv_genes = cnv.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)

print("mRNA genes/features:", len(mrna_genes))
print("Unique mRNA identifiers:", mrna_genes.nunique())

print("\nCNV genes/features:", len(cnv_genes))
print("Unique CNV identifiers:", cnv_genes.nunique())

print("\nDuplicate CNV gene identifiers:",
      cnv_genes.duplicated().sum())

print("\nCNV identifiers containing '|':",
      cnv_genes.str.contains(r"\|", regex=True).sum())

print("\nExamples containing '|':")
print(
    cnv_genes[
        cnv_genes.str.contains(r"\|", regex=True)
    ].head(20).tolist()
)

print("\nFirst 30 CNV genes:")
print(cnv_genes.head(30).tolist())

import os
import random
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import pearsonr

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

BASE = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar"

LABEL_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_label_num.csv")
MRNA_PATH  = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_mRNA.csv")
CNV_PATH   = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_CNV.csv")

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "mandatory_analysis")
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

random.seed(SEED)
np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

print("Device:", device)

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

labels_df = pd.read_csv(LABEL_PATH)
mrna_raw  = pd.read_csv(MRNA_PATH)
cnv_raw   = pd.read_csv(CNV_PATH)

print("Labels:", labels_df.shape)
print("mRNA:", mrna_raw.shape)
print("CNV:", cnv_raw.shape)

# ============================================================
# SAMPLE IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

mrna_samples = mrna_raw.columns[1:].tolist()
cnv_samples  = cnv_raw.columns[1:].tolist()

assert mrna_samples == cnv_samples
assert len(labels_df) == len(mrna_samples)

sample_ids = np.array(mrna_samples)
labels = labels_df["Label"].values

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

mrna_genes = mrna_raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).values

cnv_gene_raw = cnv_raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)

# for enrichment:
# SNORA73|ENSG... -> SNORA73
cnv_gene_clean = (
    cnv_gene_raw
    .str.split("|", regex=False)
    .str[0]
    .str.strip()
    .values
)

# ============================================================
# TRANSPOSE
# Current files = genes x samples
# Models require = samples x genes
# ============================================================

X = mrna_raw.iloc[:, 1:].T.astype(np.float32).values
Y = cnv_raw.iloc[:, 1:].T.astype(np.float32).values

print("X mRNA:", X.shape)
print("Y CNV:", Y.shape)

# ============================================================
# TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST
# 60% / 15% / 25%
# ============================================================

indices = np.arange(len(labels))

train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
    indices,
    test_size=0.40,
    random_state=SEED,
    stratify=labels
)

val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
    temp_idx,
    test_size=0.625,       # 25 / 40 = .625
    random_state=SEED,
    stratify=labels[temp_idx]
)

print("Train:", len(train_idx))
print("Validation:", len(val_idx))
print("Test:", len(test_idx))

# ============================================================
# STANDARDIZATION
# FIT ONLY ON TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================

x_scaler = StandardScaler()
y_scaler = StandardScaler()

X_train = x_scaler.fit_transform(X[train_idx]).astype(np.float32)
X_val   = x_scaler.transform(X[val_idx]).astype(np.float32)
X_test  = x_scaler.transform(X[test_idx]).astype(np.float32)

Y_train = y_scaler.fit_transform(Y[train_idx]).astype(np.float32)
Y_val   = y_scaler.transform(Y[val_idx]).astype(np.float32)
Y_test  = y_scaler.transform(Y[test_idx]).astype(np.float32)

test_sample_ids = sample_ids[test_idx]

print("Prepared.")

# ============================================================
# FULL CROSS-MODAL MODEL
# 3217 -> 512 -> 128 -> 512 -> 3105
# ============================================================

class CrossModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        input_dim,
        output_dim,
        hidden1=512,
        bottleneck=128,
        hidden2=512,
        nonlinear=True
    ):
        super().__init__()

        activation = nn.ReLU if nonlinear else nn.Identity

        self.model = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden1),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(hidden1, bottleneck),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(bottleneck, hidden2),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(hidden2, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.model(x)


def train_model(
    model,
    X_train,
    Y_train,
    X_val,
    Y_val,
    epochs=10,
    batch_size=128,
    learning_rate=0.001,
    patience=3
):

    model = model.to(device)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_train),
        torch.tensor(Y_train)
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True
    )

    X_val_t = torch.tensor(X_val).to(device)
    Y_val_t = torch.tensor(Y_val).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_state = None
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):

        model.train()

        epoch_losses = []

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            pred = model(xb)

            loss = criterion(pred, yb)

            loss.backward()

            optimizer.step()

            epoch_losses.append(loss.item())

        model.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():
            val_pred = model(X_val_t)
            val_loss = criterion(val_pred, Y_val_t).item()

        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1:02d} | "
            f"Train={np.mean(epoch_losses):.5f} | "
            f"Val={val_loss:.5f}"
        )

        if val_loss < best_loss:

            best_loss = val_loss

            best_state = {
                key: value.detach().cpu().clone()
                for key, value in model.state_dict().items()
            }

            patience_counter = 0

        else:

            patience_counter += 1

            if patience_counter >= patience:
                print("Early stopping.")
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    return model

from scipy.stats import pearsonr
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

gene_results = []

for j in range(Y_test.shape[1]):

    gene = cnv_gene_clean[j]
    raw_gene = cnv_gene_raw.iloc[j]

    gene_mask = mask[:, j]
    n_masked = int(gene_mask.sum())

    if n_masked < 10:
        continue

    y_true = Y_test[gene_mask, j]
    y_neural = neural_pred[gene_mask, j]
    y_knn = knn_pred[gene_mask, j]

    neural_mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_neural)
    knn_mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_knn)

    if np.std(y_true) > 0 and np.std(y_neural) > 0:
        neural_r = pearsonr(y_true, y_neural)[0]
    else:
        neural_r = np.nan

    if np.std(y_true) > 0 and np.std(y_knn) > 0:
        knn_r = pearsonr(y_true, y_knn)[0]
    else:
        knn_r = np.nan

    gene_results.append({
        "gene": gene,
        "raw_identifier": raw_gene,
        "n_masked": n_masked,
        "neural_r": neural_r,
        "knn_r": knn_r,
        "delta_r": neural_r - knn_r,
        "neural_mse": neural_mse,
        "knn_mse": knn_mse,
        "delta_mse": knn_mse - neural_mse
    })

gene_results = pd.DataFrame(gene_results)

gene_results.replace(
    [np.inf, -np.inf],
    np.nan,
    inplace=True
)

print("Genes evaluated:", len(gene_results))
print("Genes with valid delta_r:", gene_results["delta_r"].notna().sum())
print("Genes where Neural has higher Pearson r than KNN:",
      (gene_results["delta_r"] > 0).sum())
print("Genes where Neural has lower MSE than KNN:",
      (gene_results["delta_mse"] > 0).sum())

display(
    gene_results.sort_values(
        "delta_r",
        ascending=False
    ).head(20)
)

# ============================================================================ 
# Step 6: Simulating Missing Omics Data (Jupyter Classic Notebook Version)
# Creates 27 plots:
#   • 3 Missingness Types: Random, Targeted by Samples, Targeted by Features
#   • 3 Missingness Levels (5%, 10%, 20%)
#   • 3 Plots per combination: Heatmap, per-sample, per-feature
# Also saves 9 masked CNV datasets
# ============================================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)

# Use your CNV scaled dataset
DATA_NAME = "CNV"
DATA_DF = CNV_scaled  # already scaled earlier

# Create folders locally inside the Jupyter environment
save_dir = "/home/jupyter/missingness_plots"
miss_dir = "/home/jupyter/missingness_versions"

os.makedirs(save_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(miss_dir, exist_ok=True)


# ---------------------------
# Masking Functions
# ---------------------------
def inject_random_mask(df, p):
    mask = (np.random.rand(*df.shape) >= p).astype(np.int8)
    masked = df.copy()
    masked.values[mask == 0] = np.nan
    return masked, pd.DataFrame(mask, index=df.index, columns=df.columns)


def inject_targeted_by_samples(df, p, sample_frac=0.3):
    n = df.shape[0]
    sel_n = max(1, int(sample_frac * n))
    selected = np.random.choice(df.index, size=sel_n, replace=False)

    heavy = min(0.95, p + 0.15)
    light = p / 2

    mask = np.ones(df.shape, dtype=np.int8)

    mask[df.index.isin(selected), :] = (
        np.random.rand(sel_n, df.shape[1]) >= heavy
    ).astype(np.int8)

    rest = df.index.difference(selected)
    mask[df.index.get_indexer(rest), :] = (
        np.random.rand(len(rest), df.shape[1]) >= light
    ).astype(np.int8)

    masked = df.copy()
    masked.values[mask == 0] = np.nan
    return masked, pd.DataFrame(mask, index=df.index, columns=df.columns)


def inject_targeted_by_features(df, p, topk=500):
    var = df.var(axis=0)
    top_feats = var.sort_values(ascending=False).head(min(topk, df.shape[1])).index

    heavy = min(0.95, p + 0.15)
    light = p / 2

    mask = np.ones(df.shape, dtype=np.int8)

    # heavy missingness on top variable features
    mask[:, df.columns.get_indexer(top_feats)] = (
        np.random.rand(df.shape[0], len(top_feats)) >= heavy
    ).astype(np.int8)

    rest = df.columns.difference(top_feats)
    mask[:, df.columns.get_indexer(rest)] = (
        np.random.rand(df.shape[0], len(rest)) >= light
    ).astype(np.int8)

    masked = df.copy()
    masked.values[mask == 0] = np.nan
    return masked, pd.DataFrame(mask, index=df.index, columns=df.columns)


# ---------------------------
# Display Inline Plots
# ---------------------------
def display_plots(mask_df, missing_type, p):
    title_prefix = f"{missing_type} Missingness – {int(p*100)}%"

    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print(f" {title_prefix}")
    print("="*80)

    # Heatmap of subset
    r = min(150, mask_df.shape[0])
    c = min(50, mask_df.shape[1])
    sub = mask_df.sample(r).sample(c, axis=1)

    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
    sns.heatmap(1 - sub, cmap="magma", cbar=False)
    plt.title(f"{title_prefix} – Heatmap (1 = Missing)")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # Missingness per sample
    plt.figure(figsize=(5, 4))
    (mask_df == 0).mean(axis=1).hist(bins=20)
    plt.title(f"{title_prefix} – Missingness per Sample")
    plt.xlabel("Fraction Missing")
    plt.ylabel("Samples")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # Missingness per feature
    plt.figure(figsize=(5, 4))
    (mask_df == 0).mean(axis=0).hist(bins=20)
    plt.title(f"{title_prefix} – Missingness per Feature")
    plt.xlabel("Fraction Missing")
    plt.ylabel("Features")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()


# ============================================================================ 
# Generate 27 Graphs + Save 9 Missingness Datasets
# ============================================================================

levels = [0.05, 0.10, 0.20]  # 5%, 10%, 20%

for p in levels:

    # 1) Random Missingness
    rnd_masked, rnd_mask = inject_random_mask(DATA_DF, p)
    display_plots(rnd_mask, "Random", p)
    rnd_masked.to_parquet(os.path.join(miss_dir, f"CNV_missing_random_{int(p*100)}.parquet"))

    # 2) Targeted by Samples
    ts_masked, ts_mask = inject_targeted_by_samples(DATA_DF, p)
    display_plots(ts_mask, "Targeted-Samples", p)
    ts_masked.to_parquet(os.path.join(miss_dir, f"CNV_missing_samples_{int(p*100)}.parquet"))

    # 3) Targeted by Features
    tf_masked, tf_mask = inject_targeted_by_features(DATA_DF, p)
    display_plots(tf_mask, "Targeted-Features", p)
    tf_masked.to_parquet(os.path.join(miss_dir, f"CNV_missing_features_{int(p*100)}.parquet"))


print("\nAll missingness graphs displayed successfully.")
print("Masked CNV datasets saved to:", miss_dir)

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# ============================================================
# Local paths (DO NOT CHANGE)
# ============================================================

miss_dir = "/home/jupyter/missingness_versions"
imp_dir = "/home/jupyter/baseline_imputations"
os.makedirs(imp_dir, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading masked CNV datasets from:", miss_dir)
print("Saving imputations to:", imp_dir)


# ============================================================
# OPTIMIZATION: Use only top 100 mRNA genes for regression
# ============================================================

top_mrna = mRNA_scaled.var().sort_values(ascending=False).head(100).index
mRNA_reg_np = mRNA_scaled[top_mrna].values

print("Selected top variable mRNA features for regression:", len(top_mrna))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Run Mean, KNN, Regression imputations on a masked CNV dataset
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_imputations(CNV_missing_df, label):

    results = {}
    X = CNV_missing_df.values.copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. MEAN IMPUTATION (very fast)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    col_means = np.nanmean(X, axis=0)
    mean_imp_np = np.where(np.isnan(X), col_means, X)

    results["mean"] = pd.DataFrame(
        mean_imp_np, index=CNV_missing_df.index, columns=CNV_missing_df.columns
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. KNN IMPUTATION (n_neighbors=2 for speed)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    knn = KNNImputer(n_neighbors=2)
    knn_imp_np = knn.fit_transform(X)

    results["knn"] = pd.DataFrame(
        knn_imp_np, index=CNV_missing_df.index, columns=CNV_missing_df.columns
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. REGRESSION IMPUTATION 
    #    - Only regress first 15 columns
    #    - Only use top 100 mRNA genes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    reg = LinearRegression()
    reg_imp = X.copy()

    max_cols = min(15, X.shape[1])  # reduced from 30 → 15

    for col_idx in range(max_cols):

        col_vals = X[:, col_idx]
        mask = np.isnan(col_vals)

        if mask.any():
            reg.fit(mRNA_reg_np[~mask], col_vals[~mask])
            reg_imp[mask, col_idx] = reg.predict(mRNA_reg_np[mask])

    results["regression"] = pd.DataFrame(
        reg_imp, index=CNV_missing_df.index, columns=CNV_missing_df.columns
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # SAVE ALL RESULTS (unchanged)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    for method, df in results.items():
        out_path = os.path.join(imp_dir, f"{label}_{method}.parquet")
        df.to_parquet(out_path)
        print(f"Saved {method} → {out_path}")

    return results


# ============================================================================
# MAIN LOOP — APPLY IMPUTATIONS TO ALL MISSINGNESS FILES
# ============================================================================
missingness_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(miss_dir) if f.endswith(".parquet")])

print("\nFound missingness datasets:", len(missingness_files))

for file in missingness_files:

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print("Processing:", file)
    print("="*70)

    df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(miss_dir, file))
    run_imputations(df, file.replace(".parquet", ""))


print("\nAll baseline imputations completed!")
print("Saved in:", imp_dir)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: Autoencoder (MLP) for Generative Imputation
# ============================================================================

import os
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

miss_dir = "/home/jupyter/missingness_versions"       # masked CNV datasets
ae_dir   = "/home/jupyter/autoencoder_imputations"    # save AE outputs here
os.makedirs(ae_dir, exist_ok=True)

print("Using missingness files from:", miss_dir)
print("Saving autoencoder imputations to:", ae_dir)


# ============================================================
# DEVICE SETUP (GPU if available)
# ============================================================
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print("Using device:", DEVICE)


# ============================================================
# Autoencoder (MLP) Model
# ============================================================

class MLPImputer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim, h=512, bottleneck=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, h), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(h, bottleneck), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(bottleneck, h), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(h, out_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


# Input sizes
in_dim  = mRNA_scaled.shape[1]
out_dim = CNV_scaled.shape[1]

model = MLPImputer(in_dim, out_dim).to(DEVICE)


# ============================================================
# Prepare Training Data
# ============================================================

X = torch.tensor(mRNA_scaled.values, dtype=torch.float32)
Y = torch.tensor(CNV_scaled.values,  dtype=torch.float32)

ds = TensorDataset(X, Y)
dl = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=128, shuffle=True)


# ============================================================
# Training Setup
# ============================================================

optim_ = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()

EPOCHS = 10  # increase to 25 or 50 if you want better reconstruction


# ============================================================
# Train the Autoencoder
# ============================================================

for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
    model.train()
    total = 0.0

    for xb, yb in dl:
        xb, yb = xb.to(DEVICE), yb.to(DEVICE)

        pred = model(xb)
        loss = loss_fn(pred, yb)

        optim_.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optim_.step()

        total += loss.item() * xb.size(0)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} | Train MSE: {total/len(ds):.6f}")


# ============================================================
# Predict CNV for *all* samples (full reconstruction)
# ============================================================

model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    CNV_pred_all = model(
        torch.tensor(mRNA_scaled.values, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)
    ).cpu().numpy()

CNV_pred_df = pd.DataFrame(
    CNV_pred_all, index=mRNA_scaled.index, columns=CNV_scaled.columns
)


# ============================================================
# Impute each masked CNV dataset using the AE predictions
# ============================================================

miss_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(miss_dir) if f.endswith(".parquet")])

for file in miss_files:

    label = file.replace(".parquet", "")
    CNV_missing_df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(miss_dir, file))

    filled = CNV_missing_df.copy()
    na_locs = filled.isna()

    # fill NaNs only
    filled[na_locs] = CNV_pred_df[na_locs]

    # safety fallback (should rarely run)
    filled = filled.fillna(filled.mean())

    out_path = os.path.join(ae_dir, f"{label}_mlpAE.parquet")
    filled.to_parquet(out_path)

    print("Saved:", out_path)

print("\nAutoencoder imputation completed!")
print("Files saved to:", ae_dir)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 9: Evaluation Metrics for All Imputation Methods (SAFE VERSION)
# Handles NaNs properly before metric calculations.
# ============================================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

MISSING_DIR = "/home/jupyter/missingness_versions"
BASELINE_DIR = "/home/jupyter/baseline_imputations"
AE_DIR = "/home/jupyter/autoencoder_imputations"

true_CNV = CNV_scaled.copy()

def masked_corr(a, b):
    if len(a) < 3:
        return np.nan
    return pearsonr(a, b)[0]

missing_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(MISSING_DIR) if f.endswith(".parquet")])
results = []

print("Evaluating", len(missing_files), "missingness datasets...")

for file in missing_files:

    label = file.replace(".parquet", "")
    print("\n---------------------------------------------------------")
    print("Evaluating:", label)
    print("---------------------------------------------------------")

    missing_df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(MISSING_DIR, file))
    mask = missing_df.isna().values
    y_true = true_CNV.values[mask]

    methods = ["mean", "knn", "regression", "mlpAE"]

    for method in methods:

        if method == "mlpAE":
            imp_path = os.path.join(AE_DIR, f"{label}_{method}.parquet")
        else:
            imp_path = os.path.join(BASELINE_DIR, f"{label}_{method}.parquet")

        if not os.path.exists(imp_path):
            print("Missing:", imp_path)
            continue

        imp_df = pd.read_parquet(imp_path)

        # -------- FIX: Remove ALL NaNs before metric calculations --------
        imp_df = imp_df.fillna(imp_df.mean())

        y_pred = imp_df.values[mask]

        # Now safe to compute metrics
        mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
        r2  = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)
        corr = masked_corr(y_true, y_pred)

        results.append({
            "Missingness": label,
            "Method": method,
            "MSE": mse,
            "R2": r2,
            "Correlation": corr
        })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print("\nEvaluation complete!")
results_df

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score

# Directories
MISSING_DIR = "/home/jupyter/missingness_versions"
BASELINE_DIR = "/home/jupyter/baseline_imputations"
AE_DIR = "/home/jupyter/autoencoder_imputations"

# Ground truth CNV (scaled)
X_true = CNV_scaled.values
y = labels  # cancer labels

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
def evaluate_classifier(X, label):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y
    )

    clf = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=20,
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42
    )

    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    pred = clf.predict(X_test)

    return {
        "Dataset": label,
        "Accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "F1_macro": f1_score(y_test, pred, average="macro")
    }

# -----------------------------
# Evaluate Original CNV
# -----------------------------
results = []
results.append(evaluate_classifier(X_true, "Original_CNV"))

# -----------------------------
# Evaluate baseline imputations
# -----------------------------
baseline_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(BASELINE_DIR) if f.endswith(".parquet")])

for file in baseline_files:
    df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(BASELINE_DIR, file))
    df = df.fillna(df.mean())
    results.append(evaluate_classifier(df.values, file.replace(".parquet", "")))

# -----------------------------
# Evaluate Autoencoder imputations
# -----------------------------
ae_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(AE_DIR) if f.endswith(".parquet")])

for file in ae_files:
    df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(AE_DIR, file))
    df = df.fillna(df.mean())
    results.append(evaluate_classifier(df.values, file.replace(".parquet", "")))

# Put into a DataFrame
clf_results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print("\nClassification evaluation complete!")
clf_results_df

import os
import random
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import pearsonr

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

BASE = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar"

LABEL_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_label_num.csv")
MRNA_PATH  = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_mRNA.csv")
CNV_PATH   = os.path.join(BASE, "Pan-cancer_CNV.csv")

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "mandatory_analysis")
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

random.seed(SEED)
np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

print("Device:", device)

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

labels_df = pd.read_csv(LABEL_PATH)
mrna_raw  = pd.read_csv(MRNA_PATH)
cnv_raw   = pd.read_csv(CNV_PATH)

print("Labels:", labels_df.shape)
print("mRNA:", mrna_raw.shape)
print("CNV:", cnv_raw.shape)

# ============================================================
# SAMPLE IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

mrna_samples = mrna_raw.columns[1:].tolist()
cnv_samples  = cnv_raw.columns[1:].tolist()

assert mrna_samples == cnv_samples
assert len(labels_df) == len(mrna_samples)

sample_ids = np.array(mrna_samples)
labels = labels_df["Label"].values

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

mrna_genes = mrna_raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).values

cnv_gene_raw = cnv_raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)

# for enrichment:
# SNORA73|ENSG... -> SNORA73
cnv_gene_clean = (
    cnv_gene_raw
    .str.split("|", regex=False)
    .str[0]
    .str.strip()
    .values
)

# ============================================================
# TRANSPOSE
# Current files = genes x samples
# Models require = samples x genes
# ============================================================

X = mrna_raw.iloc[:, 1:].T.astype(np.float32).values
Y = cnv_raw.iloc[:, 1:].T.astype(np.float32).values

print("X mRNA:", X.shape)
print("Y CNV:", Y.shape)

# ============================================================
# TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST
# 60% / 15% / 25%
# ============================================================

indices = np.arange(len(labels))

train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
    indices,
    test_size=0.40,
    random_state=SEED,
    stratify=labels
)

val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
    temp_idx,
    test_size=0.625,       # 25 / 40 = .625
    random_state=SEED,
    stratify=labels[temp_idx]
)

print("Train:", len(train_idx))
print("Validation:", len(val_idx))
print("Test:", len(test_idx))

# ============================================================
# STANDARDIZATION
# FIT ONLY ON TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================

x_scaler = StandardScaler()
y_scaler = StandardScaler()

X_train = x_scaler.fit_transform(X[train_idx]).astype(np.float32)
X_val   = x_scaler.transform(X[val_idx]).astype(np.float32)
X_test  = x_scaler.transform(X[test_idx]).astype(np.float32)

Y_train = y_scaler.fit_transform(Y[train_idx]).astype(np.float32)
Y_val   = y_scaler.transform(Y[val_idx]).astype(np.float32)
Y_test  = y_scaler.transform(Y[test_idx]).astype(np.float32)

test_sample_ids = sample_ids[test_idx]

print("Prepared.")

# ============================================================
# FULL CROSS-MODAL MODEL
# 3217 -> 512 -> 128 -> 512 -> 3105
# ============================================================

class CrossModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        input_dim,
        output_dim,
        hidden1=512,
        bottleneck=128,
        hidden2=512,
        nonlinear=True
    ):
        super().__init__()

        activation = nn.ReLU if nonlinear else nn.Identity

        self.model = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden1),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(hidden1, bottleneck),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(bottleneck, hidden2),
            activation(),
            nn.Linear(hidden2, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.model(x)


def train_model(
    model,
    X_train,
    Y_train,
    X_val,
    Y_val,
    epochs=10,
    batch_size=128,
    learning_rate=0.001,
    patience=3
):

    model = model.to(device)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_train),
        torch.tensor(Y_train)
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True
    )

    X_val_t = torch.tensor(X_val).to(device)
    Y_val_t = torch.tensor(Y_val).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_state = None
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):

        model.train()

        epoch_losses = []

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            pred = model(xb)

            loss = criterion(pred, yb)

            loss.backward()

            optimizer.step()

            epoch_losses.append(loss.item())

        model.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():
            val_pred = model(X_val_t)
            val_loss = criterion(val_pred, Y_val_t).item()

        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1:02d} | "
            f"Train={np.mean(epoch_losses):.5f} | "
            f"Val={val_loss:.5f}"
        )

        if val_loss < best_loss:

            best_loss = val_loss

            best_state = {
                key: value.detach().cpu().clone()
                for key, value in model.state_dict().items()
            }

            patience_counter = 0

        else:

            patience_counter += 1

            if patience_counter >= patience:
                print("Early stopping.")
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    return model

        else np.nan

    np.nan,
    inplace=True
)

)

    (gene_results["delta_mse"] <= 0)
)

)

both_worse = (

)

# FUNCTIONAL ENRICHMENT
# STEP 1: Rank genes by Neural reconstruction quality
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

neural_gene_results = []

for j in range(Y_test.shape[1]):

    gene = cnv_gene_clean[j]
    raw_gene = cnv_gene_raw.iloc[j]

    gene_mask = mask[:, j]
    n_masked = int(gene_mask.sum())

    if n_masked < 10:
        continue

    y_true = Y_test[gene_mask, j]
    y_pred = neural_pred[gene_mask, j]

    mse = mean_squared_error(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    if (
        np.std(y_true) > 0 and
        np.std(y_pred) > 0
    ):
        r = pearsonr(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )[0]
    else:
        r = np.nan

    neural_gene_results.append({
        "gene": gene,
        "raw_identifier": raw_gene,
        "n_masked": n_masked,
        "neural_r": r,
        "neural_mse": mse
    })

neural_gene_results = pd.DataFrame(
    neural_gene_results
)

neural_gene_results = (
    neural_gene_results
    .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    .dropna(subset=["neural_r", "neural_mse"])
)

print(
    "Genes evaluated:",
    len(neural_gene_results)
)

print(
    "Median Neural Pearson r:",
    neural_gene_results["neural_r"].median()
)

print(
    "Median Neural MSE:",
    neural_gene_results["neural_mse"].median()
)

print(
    "\nGenes with r >= 0.50:",
    (neural_gene_results["neural_r"] >= 0.50).sum()
)

print(

    (neural_gene_results["neural_r"] >= 0.60).sum()
)

print(
    "Genes with r >= 0.70:",
    (neural_gene_results["neural_r"] >= 0.70).sum()
)

print("\nTop 20 genes by Neural Pearson r:")

display(
    neural_gene_results
    .sort_values(
        "neural_r",
        ascending=False
    )
    .head(20)
)

# ============================================================
# FUNCTIONAL ENRICHMENT
# STEP 2: Create robust reconstruction-quality ranking
# ============================================================

enrichment_rank = neural_gene_results.copy()

# Higher Pearson r = better
enrichment_rank["rank_r"] = (
    enrichment_rank["neural_r"]
    .rank(method="average", pct=True)
)

# Lower MSE = better
enrichment_rank["rank_mse"] = (
    (-enrichment_rank["neural_mse"])
    .rank(method="average", pct=True)
)

# Equal-weight rank-based quality score
enrichment_rank["quality_score"] = (
    enrichment_rank["rank_r"] +
    enrichment_rank["rank_mse"]
) / 2

# Remove duplicated cleaned gene symbols
# Keep the best-performing occurrence if duplicates exist
enrichment_rank = (
    enrichment_rank
    .sort_values("quality_score", ascending=False)
    .drop_duplicates(subset="gene", keep="first")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

print("Unique genes available for enrichment:",
      len(enrichment_rank))

print("\nQuality score summary:")
print(enrichment_rank["quality_score"].describe())

print("\nTop 30 reconstruction-quality genes:")

display(
    enrichment_rank[
        [
            "gene",
            "neural_r",
            "neural_mse",
            "rank_r",
            "rank_mse",
            "quality_score"
        ]
    ].head(30)
)

# Save ranking
rank_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "functional_enrichment_gene_ranking.csv"
)

enrichment_rank.to_csv(
    rank_path,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:", rank_path)

# ============================================================
# FUNCTIONAL ENRICHMENT
# STEP 3: Ranked GO Biological Process + KEGG enrichment
# ============================================================

# Install once if needed
!pip install -q gseapy

import gseapy as gp
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare ranked gene list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rnk = enrichment_rank[
    ["gene", "quality_score"]
].copy()

# Center around zero for ranked enrichment
rnk["rank_score"] = (
    rnk["quality_score"] - 0.5
)

rnk = (
    rnk[["gene", "rank_score"]]
    .dropna()
    .sort_values("rank_score", ascending=False)
)

print("Genes supplied to enrichment:", len(rnk))

print("\nTop ranked genes:")
display(rnk.head(10))

print("\nBottom ranked genes:")
display(rnk.tail(10))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# GO Biological Process
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_res = gp.prerank(
    rnk=rnk,
    gene_sets="GO_Biological_Process_2023",
    organism="Human",
    permutation_num=1000,
    seed=42,
    min_size=10,
    max_size=500,
    outdir=None,
    verbose=True
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KEGG
# ------------------------------------------------------------

kegg_res = gp.prerank(
    rnk=rnk,
    gene_sets="KEGG_2021_Human",
    organism="Human",
    permutation_num=1000,
    seed=42,
    min_size=10,
    max_size=500,
    outdir=None,
    verbose=True
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_table = go_res.res2d.copy()
kegg_table = kegg_res.res2d.copy()

print("\nGO result columns:")
print(go_table.columns.tolist())

print("\nKEGG result columns:")
print(kegg_table.columns.tolist())


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Significant pathways
# FDR < 0.05
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_sig = go_table[
    go_table["FDR q-val"] < 0.05
].copy()

kegg_sig = kegg_table[
    kegg_table["FDR q-val"] < 0.05
].copy()

print("\nSignificant GO Biological Process pathways:",
      len(go_sig))

print("Significant KEGG pathways:",
      len(kegg_sig))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Display strongest positively enriched pathways
# NES > 0 means enrichment among better-reconstructed genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\nTOP GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS:")

display(
    go_sig[
        go_sig["NES"] > 0
    ]
    .sort_values(
        ["FDR q-val", "NES"],
        ascending=[True, False]
    )
    .head(20)
)


print("\nTOP KEGG PATHWAYS:")

display(
    kegg_sig[
        kegg_sig["NES"] > 0
    ]
    .sort_values(
        ["FDR q-val", "NES"],
        ascending=[True, False]
    )
    .head(20)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save full results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "GO_BP_ranked_enrichment.csv"
)

kegg_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "KEGG_ranked_enrichment.csv"
)

go_table.to_csv(go_path, index=False)
kegg_table.to_csv(kegg_path, index=False)

print("\nSaved:")
print(go_path)
print(kegg_path)

# ============================================================
# FUNCTIONAL ENRICHMENT
# STEP 5: Final GSEA using Neural Pearson r directly
# ============================================================

import gseapy as gp
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Continuous ranking metric:
# higher Pearson r = better neural reconstruction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rnk_final = (
    neural_gene_results[
        ["gene", "neural_r"]
    ]
    .dropna()
    .sort_values("neural_r", ascending=False)
    .drop_duplicates(subset="gene", keep="first")
)

print("Unique genes:", len(rnk_final))
print("Duplicated gene symbols:",
      rnk_final["gene"].duplicated().sum())

print("\nPearson-r summary:")
print(rnk_final["neural_r"].describe())

print("\nTop 10:")
display(rnk_final.head(10))

print("\nBottom 10:")
display(rnk_final.tail(10))


# ============================================================
# GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS
# ============================================================

go_final = gp.prerank(
    rnk=rnk_final,
    gene_sets="GO_Biological_Process_2023",
    organism="Human",
    permutation_num=1000,
    seed=42,
    min_size=10,
    max_size=500,
    outdir=None,
    verbose=True
)


# ============================================================
# KEGG
# ============================================================

kegg_final = gp.prerank(
    rnk=rnk_final,
    gene_sets="KEGG_2021_Human",
    organism="Human",
    permutation_num=1000,
    seed=42,
    min_size=10,
    max_size=500,
    outdir=None,
    verbose=True
)


# ============================================================
# RESULTS
# ============================================================

go_final_table = go_final.res2d.copy()
kegg_final_table = kegg_final.res2d.copy()

go_final_sig = go_final_table[
    go_final_table["FDR q-val"] < 0.05
].copy()

kegg_final_sig = kegg_final_table[
    kegg_final_table["FDR q-val"] < 0.05
].copy()


print("\n======================================")
print("GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS")
print("======================================")

print("Significant total:", len(go_final_sig))
print("Positive NES:",
      (go_final_sig["NES"] > 0).sum())
print("Negative NES:",
      (go_final_sig["NES"] < 0).sum())

display(
    go_final_sig[
        [
            "Term",
            "NES",
            "NOM p-val",
            "FDR q-val",
            "Lead_genes"
        ]
    ]
    .sort_values("FDR q-val")
    .head(20)
)


print("\n======================================")
print("KEGG")
print("======================================")

print("Significant total:", len(kegg_final_sig))
print("Positive NES:",
      (kegg_final_sig["NES"] > 0).sum())
print("Negative NES:",
      (kegg_final_sig["NES"] < 0).sum())

display(
    kegg_final_sig[
        [
            "Term",
            "NES",
            "NOM p-val",
            "FDR q-val",
            "Lead_genes"
        ]
    ]
    .sort_values("FDR q-val")
    .head(20)
)


# ============================================================
# SAVE FINAL RESULTS
# ============================================================

go_final_table.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "GO_BP_final_neural_r_GSEA.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

kegg_final_table.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "KEGG_final_neural_r_GSEA.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nFinal GO and KEGG results saved.")

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 1: Load TCGA-CDR and match patients
# ============================================================

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

CLINICAL_PATH = r"C:\Users\sufi\Downloads\Babar\TCGA-CDR-SupplementalTableS1.xlsx"

# Load first worksheet
clinical = pd.read_excel(
    CLINICAL_PATH,
    sheet_name=0
)

print("Clinical table shape:", clinical.shape)

print("\nClinical columns:")
print(clinical.columns.tolist())


# ============================================================
# Convert omics sample IDs to TCGA patient IDs
# Example:
# TCGA-XX-XXXX-01A -> TCGA-XX-XXXX
# ============================================================

patient_ids = np.array([
    "-".join(str(s).split("-")[:3])
    for s in sample_ids
])

print("\nOmics samples:", len(sample_ids))
print("Unique patient IDs:", len(np.unique(patient_ids)))


# ============================================================
# Identify patient-ID column in CDR
# ============================================================

candidate_id_cols = [
    "bcr_patient_barcode",
    "patient",
    "case_submitter_id",
    "Patient ID"
]

clinical_id_col = None

for col in candidate_id_cols:
    if col in clinical.columns:
        clinical_id_col = col
        break

if clinical_id_col is None:
    raise ValueError(
        "Could not automatically identify the TCGA patient ID column."
    )

print("\nClinical patient ID column:", clinical_id_col)


# ============================================================
# Match our cohort to TCGA-CDR
# ============================================================

clinical[clinical_id_col] = (
    clinical[clinical_id_col]
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
)

omics_patients = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample_id": sample_ids,
    "patient_id": patient_ids,
    "cancer_label": labels
})

matched = omics_patients.merge(
    clinical,
    left_on="patient_id",
    right_on=clinical_id_col,
    how="left",
    indicator=True
)

print("\nMatched to TCGA-CDR:",
      (matched["_merge"] == "both").sum())

print("Not matched:",
      (matched["_merge"] != "both").sum())

print("Match percentage:",
      100 * (matched["_merge"] == "both").mean())


# ============================================================
# Check Overall Survival fields
# ============================================================

possible_os_event = [
    "OS",
    "os",
    "OS_event"
]

possible_os_time = [
    "OS.time",
    "OS_time",
    "os_time"
]

os_event_col = next(
    (c for c in possible_os_event if c in matched.columns),
    None
)

os_time_col = next(
    (c for c in possible_os_time if c in matched.columns),
    None
)

print("\nOS event column:", os_event_col)
print("OS time column:", os_time_col)

if os_event_col is not None and os_time_col is not None:

    matched[os_event_col] = pd.to_numeric(
        matched[os_event_col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    matched[os_time_col] = pd.to_numeric(
        matched[os_time_col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    usable_os = (
        matched[os_event_col].notna() &
        matched[os_time_col].notna() &
        (matched[os_time_col] > 0)
    )

    print("\nUsable OS cases:", usable_os.sum())

    print("OS events/deaths:",
          (matched.loc[usable_os, os_event_col] == 1).sum())

    print("OS censored:",
          (matched.loc[usable_os, os_event_col] == 0).sum())

    print(
        "Median OS follow-up/time:",
        matched.loc[usable_os, os_time_col].median()
    )

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 2: Build leakage-controlled survival partitions
# ============================================================

# Remove merge helper column if present
matched_surv = matched.copy()

if "_merge" in matched_surv.columns:
    matched_surv = matched_surv.drop(columns=["_merge"])


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create clean survival variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

matched_surv["OS_event"] = pd.to_numeric(
    matched_surv["OS"],
    errors="coerce"
)

matched_surv["OS_time"] = pd.to_numeric(
    matched_surv["OS.time"],
    errors="coerce"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Valid overall-survival observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

valid_survival = (
    matched_surv["OS_event"].notna()
    &
    matched_surv["OS_time"].notna()
    &
    (matched_surv["OS_time"] > 0)
)

print("Total usable survival cases:",
      valid_survival.sum())


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Preserve ORIGINAL reconstruction split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

train_surv_mask = valid_survival.iloc[train_idx].values
val_surv_mask   = valid_survival.iloc[val_idx].values
test_surv_mask  = valid_survival.iloc[test_idx].values


surv_train_idx = train_idx[train_surv_mask]
surv_val_idx   = val_idx[val_surv_mask]
surv_test_idx  = test_idx[test_surv_mask]


print("\nSurvival partition sizes:")
print("Train:", len(surv_train_idx))
print("Validation:", len(surv_val_idx))
print("Test:", len(surv_test_idx))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract survival outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

time_train = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_train_idx, "OS_time"
].values.astype(float)

event_train = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_train_idx, "OS_event"
].values.astype(int)


time_val = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_val_idx, "OS_time"
].values.astype(float)

event_val = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_val_idx, "OS_event"
].values.astype(int)


time_test = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_test_idx, "OS_time"
].values.astype(float)

event_test = matched_surv.loc[
    surv_test_idx, "OS_event"
].values.astype(int)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Event statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\nTRAIN")
print("Patients:", len(time_train))
print("Deaths:", event_train.sum())
print("Censored:", len(event_train) - event_train.sum())
print("Event rate:", event_train.mean())

print("\nVALIDATION")
print("Patients:", len(time_val))
print("Deaths:", event_val.sum())
print("Censored:", len(event_val) - event_val.sum())
print("Event rate:", event_val.mean())

print("\nTEST")
print("Patients:", len(time_test))
print("Deaths:", event_test.sum())
print("Censored:", len(event_test) - event_test.sum())
print("Event rate:", event_test.mean())


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assert len(
    np.intersect1d(surv_train_idx, surv_test_idx)
) == 0

assert len(
    np.intersect1d(surv_val_idx, surv_test_idx)
) == 0

assert len(
    np.intersect1d(surv_train_idx, surv_val_idx)
) == 0

print("\nNo patient overlap between survival partitions.")

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 3: Build leakage-controlled CNV representations
# ============================================================

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import numpy as np

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Map global sample indices to positions inside split matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

train_pos = {idx: i for i, idx in enumerate(train_idx)}
val_pos   = {idx: i for i, idx in enumerate(val_idx)}
test_pos  = {idx: i for i, idx in enumerate(test_idx)}

surv_train_pos = np.array([train_pos[i] for i in surv_train_idx])
surv_val_pos   = np.array([val_pos[i] for i in surv_val_idx])
surv_test_pos  = np.array([test_pos[i] for i in surv_test_idx])


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ORIGINAL CNV
# already standardized with training-only scaler
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_train = Y_train[surv_train_pos]
orig_val   = Y_val[surv_val_pos]
orig_test  = Y_test[surv_test_pos]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEURAL reconstructed CNV
# Need predictions for train / val / test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

full_model.eval()

with torch.no_grad():

    neural_train_all = full_model(
        torch.tensor(
            X_train,
            dtype=torch.float32
        ).to(device)
    ).cpu().numpy()

    neural_val_all = full_model(
        torch.tensor(
            X_val,
            dtype=torch.float32
        ).to(device)
    ).cpu().numpy()

    neural_test_all = full_model(
        torch.tensor(
            X_test,
            dtype=torch.float32
        ).to(device)
    ).cpu().numpy()


neural_train = neural_train_all[surv_train_pos]
neural_val   = neural_val_all[surv_val_pos]
neural_test  = neural_test_all[surv_test_pos]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KNN representation
#
# For survival analysis, use complete CNV inputs and map them
# through the training-fitted KNN imputer.
# Since there are no native missing values, this preserves
# observed CNV values.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

knn_surv = KNNImputer(
    n_neighbors=3,
    weights="uniform"
)

knn_surv.fit(Y_train)

knn_train_all = knn_surv.transform(Y_train)
knn_val_all   = knn_surv.transform(Y_val)
knn_test_all  = knn_surv.transform(Y_test)

knn_train = knn_train_all[surv_train_pos]
knn_val   = knn_val_all[surv_val_pos]
knn_test  = knn_test_all[surv_test_pos]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PCA
# Fit PCA ONLY on ORIGINAL training CNV
# Use same basis for all representations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

N_COMPONENTS = 50

pca = PCA(
    n_components=N_COMPONENTS,
    random_state=42
)

pca.fit(orig_train)

orig_train_pca = pca.transform(orig_train)
orig_val_pca   = pca.transform(orig_val)
orig_test_pca  = pca.transform(orig_test)

neural_train_pca = pca.transform(neural_train)
neural_val_pca   = pca.transform(neural_val)
neural_test_pca  = pca.transform(neural_test)

knn_train_pca = pca.transform(knn_train)
knn_val_pca   = pca.transform(knn_val)
knn_test_pca  = pca.transform(knn_test)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("Explained variance by 50 PCs:",
      pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum())

print("\nOriginal PCA shapes:")
print(orig_train_pca.shape,
      orig_val_pca.shape,
      orig_test_pca.shape)

print("\nNeural PCA shapes:")
print(neural_train_pca.shape,
      neural_val_pca.shape,
      neural_test_pca.shape)

print("\nKNN PCA shapes:")
print(knn_train_pca.shape,
      knn_val_pca.shape,
      knn_test_pca.shape)

print("\nNaNs:")
print("Original:", np.isnan(orig_test_pca).sum())
print("Neural:", np.isnan(neural_test_pca).sum())
print("KNN:", np.isnan(knn_test_pca).sum())

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 4: Stratified Cox models
# Original CNV vs Neural-reconstructed CNV
# ============================================================

!pip install -q lifelines

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from lifelines import CoxPHFitter
from lifelines.utils import concordance_index


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Cancer-type labels for survival subsets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cancer_train = labels[surv_train_idx]
cancer_val   = labels[surv_val_idx]
cancer_test  = labels[surv_test_idx]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: construct Cox dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def make_cox_df(X_pca, times, events, cancer_labels):

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        X_pca,
        columns=[
            f"PC{i+1}"
            for i in range(X_pca.shape[1])
        ]
    )

    df["OS_time"] = times
    df["OS_event"] = events

    # categorical tumour stratum
    df["cancer_type"] = cancer_labels.astype(str)

    return df


orig_train_cox = make_cox_df(
    orig_train_pca,
    time_train,
    event_train,
    cancer_train
)

orig_val_cox = make_cox_df(
    orig_val_pca,
    time_val,
    event_val,
    cancer_val
)

orig_test_cox = make_cox_df(
    orig_test_pca,
    time_test,
    event_test,
    cancer_test
)


neural_train_cox = make_cox_df(
    neural_train_pca,
    time_train,
    event_train,
    cancer_train
)

neural_val_cox = make_cox_df(
    neural_val_pca,
    time_val,
    event_val,
    cancer_val
)

neural_test_cox = make_cox_df(
    neural_test_pca,
    time_test,
    event_test,
    cancer_test
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit Cox models on TRAINING DATA ONLY
#
# Penalizer stabilizes the 50-PC model.
# cancer_type is used as a stratum.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_cox = CoxPHFitter(
    penalizer=0.1
)

orig_cox.fit(
    orig_train_cox,
    duration_col="OS_time",
    event_col="OS_event",
    strata=["cancer_type"]
)


neural_cox = CoxPHFitter(
    penalizer=0.1
)

neural_cox.fit(
    neural_train_cox,
    duration_col="OS_time",
    event_col="OS_event",
    strata=["cancer_type"]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Predict risk on VALIDATION and TEST only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_val_risk = orig_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    orig_val_cox
).values.ravel()

orig_test_risk = orig_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    orig_test_cox
).values.ravel()


neural_val_risk = neural_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    neural_val_cox
).values.ravel()

neural_test_risk = neural_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    neural_test_cox
).values.ravel()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Concordance index
#
# Higher predicted hazard = shorter survival,
# so use negative risk for concordance_index().
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_val_cindex = concordance_index(
    time_val,
    -orig_val_risk,
    event_val
)

orig_test_cindex = concordance_index(
    time_test,
    -orig_test_risk,
    event_test
)

neural_val_cindex = concordance_index(
    time_val,
    -neural_val_risk,
    event_val
)

neural_test_cindex = concordance_index(
    time_test,
    -neural_test_risk,
    event_test
)


print("ORIGINAL CNV")
print("Validation C-index:", orig_val_cindex)
print("Test C-index:", orig_test_cindex)

print("\nNEURAL RECONSTRUCTED CNV")
print("Validation C-index:", neural_val_cindex)
print("Test C-index:", neural_test_cindex)

print(
    "\nTest C-index difference "
    "(Neural - Original):",
    neural_test_cindex - orig_test_cindex
)

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 5: Held-out within-cancer concordance
# ============================================================

from lifelines.utils import concordance_index
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

cancer_results = []

for cancer in np.unique(cancer_test):

    idx = np.where(cancer_test == cancer)[0]

    n = len(idx)
    deaths = int(event_test[idx].sum())

    # Require enough patients and events
    # for a meaningful cancer-specific estimate
    if n < 20 or deaths < 5:
        continue

    orig_c = concordance_index(
        time_test[idx],
        -orig_test_risk[idx],
        event_test[idx]
    )

    neural_c = concordance_index(
        time_test[idx],
        -neural_test_risk[idx],
        event_test[idx]
    )

    cancer_results.append({
        "cancer_label": int(cancer),
        "n_test": n,
        "deaths": deaths,
        "original_cindex": orig_c,
        "neural_cindex": neural_c,
        "difference": neural_c - orig_c
    })


cancer_results = pd.DataFrame(cancer_results)

print(
    "Cancer types evaluated:",
    len(cancer_results)
)

print(
    "Neural higher C-index:",
    (cancer_results["difference"] > 0).sum()
)

print(
    "Original higher/equal C-index:",
    (cancer_results["difference"] <= 0).sum()
)

print(
    "\nMedian Original C-index:",
    cancer_results["original_cindex"].median()
)

print(
    "Median Neural C-index:",
    cancer_results["neural_cindex"].median()
)

print(
    "Median difference:",
    cancer_results["difference"].median()
)


# Patient-count weighted summary
weights = cancer_results["n_test"].values

orig_weighted = np.average(
    cancer_results["original_cindex"],
    weights=weights
)

neural_weighted = np.average(
    cancer_results["neural_cindex"],
    weights=weights
)

print(
    "\nPatient-weighted Original C-index:",
    orig_weighted
)

print(
    "Patient-weighted Neural C-index:",
    neural_weighted
)

print(
    "Weighted difference:",
    neural_weighted - orig_weighted
)


print("\nCancer-specific results:")

display(
    cancer_results
    .sort_values(
        "difference",
        ascending=False
    )
)

# Save
survival_cancer_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "survival_cindex_by_cancer.csv"
)

cancer_results.to_csv(
    survival_cancer_path,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:", survival_cancer_path)

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 6: Train-defined risk groups on held-out TEST cohort
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Training risk scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_train_risk = orig_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    orig_train_cox
).values.ravel()

neural_train_risk = neural_cox.predict_partial_hazard(
    neural_train_cox
).values.ravel()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Cancer-specific TRAINING median thresholds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_thresholds = {}
neural_thresholds = {}

for cancer in np.unique(cancer_train):

    idx = np.where(cancer_train == cancer)[0]

    orig_thresholds[cancer] = np.median(
        orig_train_risk[idx]
    )

    neural_thresholds[cancer] = np.median(
        neural_train_risk[idx]
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply frozen thresholds to TEST patients
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_test_group = np.array([
    1 if orig_test_risk[i] >= orig_thresholds[cancer_test[i]]
    else 0
    for i in range(len(cancer_test))
])

neural_test_group = np.array([
    1 if neural_test_risk[i] >= neural_thresholds[cancer_test[i]]
    else 0
    for i in range(len(cancer_test))
])


print("ORIGINAL CNV")
print("Low risk:", (orig_test_group == 0).sum())
print("High risk:", (orig_test_group == 1).sum())
print(
    "Deaths low risk:",
    event_test[orig_test_group == 0].sum()
)
print(
    "Deaths high risk:",
    event_test[orig_test_group == 1].sum()
)


print("\nNEURAL RECONSTRUCTED CNV")
print("Low risk:", (neural_test_group == 0).sum())
print("High risk:", (neural_test_group == 1).sum())
print(
    "Deaths low risk:",
    event_test[neural_test_group == 0].sum()
)
print(
    "Deaths high risk:",
    event_test[neural_test_group == 1].sum()
)


# ============================================================
# Held-out TEST Cox validation
# One binary risk-group predictor
# Stratified by cancer type
# ============================================================

def test_group_cox(group):

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "OS_time": time_test,
        "OS_event": event_test,
        "risk_group": group,
        "cancer_type": cancer_test.astype(str)
    })

    cph = CoxPHFitter()

    cph.fit(
        df,
        duration_col="OS_time",
        event_col="OS_event",
        strata=["cancer_type"]
    )

    return cph


orig_group_cox = test_group_cox(
    orig_test_group
)

neural_group_cox = test_group_cox(
    neural_test_group
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract hazard ratios
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_hr = np.exp(
    orig_group_cox.params_["risk_group"]
)

orig_ci_low = np.exp(
    orig_group_cox.confidence_intervals_.loc[
        "risk_group", "95% lower-bound"
    ]
)

orig_ci_high = np.exp(
    orig_group_cox.confidence_intervals_.loc[
        "risk_group", "95% upper-bound"
    ]
)

orig_p = orig_group_cox.summary.loc[
    "risk_group", "p"
]


neural_hr = np.exp(
    neural_group_cox.params_["risk_group"]
)

neural_ci_low = np.exp(
    neural_group_cox.confidence_intervals_.loc[
        "risk_group", "95% lower-bound"
    ]
)

neural_ci_high = np.exp(
    neural_group_cox.confidence_intervals_.loc[
        "risk_group", "95% upper-bound"
    ]
)

neural_p = neural_group_cox.summary.loc[
    "risk_group", "p"
]


print("\n===================================")
print("HELD-OUT TEST SURVIVAL VALIDATION")
print("===================================")

print("\nOriginal CNV")
print("HR:", orig_hr)
print("95% CI:", orig_ci_low, "-", orig_ci_high)
print("p-value:", orig_p)

print("\nNeural reconstructed CNV")
print("HR:", neural_hr)
print("95% CI:", neural_ci_low, "-", neural_ci_high)
print("p-value:", neural_p)

# ============================================================
# SURVIVAL / PROGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# STEP 7: Kaplan-Meier curves on HELD-OUT TEST cohort
# ============================================================

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test
import os


def plot_km(
    groups,
    title,
    filename
):

    kmf_low = KaplanMeierFitter()
    kmf_high = KaplanMeierFitter()

    low = groups == 0
    high = groups == 1

    # Log-rank test
    lr = logrank_test(
        time_test[low],
        time_test[high],
        event_observed_A=event_test[low],
        event_observed_B=event_test[high]
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))

    kmf_low.fit(
        time_test[low],
        event_test[low],
        label=f"Low risk (n={low.sum()})"
    )

    kmf_high.fit(
        time_test[high],
        event_test[high],
        label=f"High risk (n={high.sum()})"
    )

    kmf_low.plot_survival_function(
        ax=ax,
        ci_show=True
    )

    kmf_high.plot_survival_function(
        ax=ax,
        ci_show=True
    )

    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Overall survival time (days)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Survival probability")

    ax.text(
        0.97,
        0.08,
        f"Log-rank p = {lr.p_value:.3e}",
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        horizontalalignment="right"
    )

    plt.tight_layout()

    save_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        filename
    )

    plt.savefig(
        save_path,
        dpi=300,
        bbox_inches="tight"
    )

    plt.show()

    return lr.p_value, save_path


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Original CNV
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_logrank_p, orig_km_path = plot_km(
    orig_test_group,
    "Overall Survival: Original CNV",
    "KM_original_CNV.png"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Neural reconstructed CNV
# ------------------------------------------------------------

neural_logrank_p, neural_km_path = plot_km(
    neural_test_group,
    "Overall Survival: Neural-Reconstructed CNV",
    "KM_neural_reconstructed_CNV.png"
)


print("\nOriginal CNV log-rank p:",
      orig_logrank_p)

print("Neural CNV log-rank p:",
      neural_logrank_p)

print("\nSaved:")
print(orig_km_path)
print(neural_km_path)
