# ============================================================
# ABLATION STUDY
# Full cross-modal model vs architectural variants
# 5 independent training seeds
# ============================================================

import os
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr


# ============================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

ABLATION_SEEDS = [42, 123, 456, 789, 1011]

def set_seed(seed):

    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    # More deterministic GPU behaviour
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False


# ============================================================
# 2. MODEL DEFINITIONS
# ============================================================

class FullModel(nn.Module):
    """
    3217 -> 512 -> 128 -> 512 -> 3105
    ReLU nonlinearities
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class NoNonlinearityModel(nn.Module):
    """
    Same dimensions as Full model,
    but removes all ReLU nonlinearities.
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, 128),
            nn.Linear(128, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ShallowModel(nn.Module):
    """
    3217 -> 128 -> 3105
    Tests importance of depth.
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class Bottleneck64Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Narrower latent bottleneck.
    3217 -> 512 -> 64 -> 512 -> 3105
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class Bottleneck256Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Wider latent bottleneck.
    3217 -> 512 -> 256 -> 512 -> 3105
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class NoBottleneckModel(nn.Module):
    """
    Removes compact latent bottleneck.
    3217 -> 512 -> 512 -> 3105
    """
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Linear(512, output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


# ============================================================
# 3. TRAINING FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def train_ablation_model(
    model,
    X_train,
    Y_train,
    X_val,
    Y_val,
    seed,
    epochs=10,
    batch_size=128,
    learning_rate=0.001,
    patience=3
):

    set_seed(seed)

    model = model.to(device)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_train, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(Y_train, dtype=torch.float32)
    )

    # Explicit seeded generator for DataLoader shuffle
    generator = torch.Generator()
    generator.manual_seed(seed)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        generator=generator
    )

    X_val_t = torch.tensor(
        X_val,
        dtype=torch.float32,
        device=device
    )

    Y_val_t = torch.tensor(
        Y_val,
        dtype=torch.float32,
        device=device
    )

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_state = None
    best_epoch = None

    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):

        model.train()

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            pred = model(xb)

            loss = criterion(pred, yb)

            loss.backward()

            optimizer.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            val_pred = model(X_val_t)

            val_loss = criterion(
                val_pred,
                Y_val_t
            ).item()

        if val_loss < best_loss:

            best_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch + 1

            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }

            patience_counter = 0

        else:

            patience_counter += 1

            if patience_counter >= patience:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    return model, best_loss, best_epoch


# ============================================================
# 4. ARCHITECTURES
# ============================================================

model_builders = {

    "Full_512-128-512":
        lambda: FullModel(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        ),

    "No_Nonlinearity":
        lambda: NoNonlinearityModel(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        ),

    "Shallow_128":
        lambda: ShallowModel(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        ),

    "Bottleneck_64":
        lambda: Bottleneck64Model(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        ),

    "Bottleneck_256":
        lambda: Bottleneck256Model(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        ),

    "No_Bottleneck":
        lambda: NoBottleneckModel(
            X_train.shape[1],
            Y_train.shape[1]
        )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. RUN ABLATION
# ============================================================

ablation_results = []

for model_name, builder in model_builders.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("MODEL:", model_name)
    print("=" * 80)

    for seed in ABLATION_SEEDS:

        print("Seed:", seed)

        # IMPORTANT:
        # set seed BEFORE model construction
        set_seed(seed)

        model = builder()

        model, best_val_loss, best_epoch = train_ablation_model(
            model,
            X_train,
            Y_train,
            X_val,
            Y_val,
            seed=seed,
            epochs=10,
            batch_size=128,
            learning_rate=0.001,
            patience=3
        )

        # --------------------------------------------
        # Predict held-out test CNV
        # --------------------------------------------

        model.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            pred_test = model(
                torch.tensor(
                    X_test,
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                    device=device
                )
            ).cpu().numpy()

        # --------------------------------------------
        # Evaluate SAME intentionally masked entries
        # --------------------------------------------

        y_true = Y_test[mask]
        y_pred = pred_test[mask]

        mse = mean_squared_error(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )

        r2 = r2_score(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )

        r = pearsonr(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )[0]

        # Number of trainable parameters
        n_params = sum(
            p.numel()
            for p in model.parameters()
            if p.requires_grad
        )

        ablation_results.append({

            "model": model_name,
            "seed": seed,

            "best_epoch": best_epoch,
            "best_val_mse": best_val_loss,

            "test_mse": mse,
            "test_r2": r2,
            "test_pearson_r": r,

            "parameters": n_params
        })

        print(
            f"Epoch={best_epoch} | "
            f"MSE={mse:.4f} | "
            f"R2={r2:.4f} | "
            f"r={r:.4f}"
        )


# ============================================================
# 6. RESULTS TABLE
# ============================================================

ablation_results = pd.DataFrame(
    ablation_results
)

print("\nRaw ablation runs:")
display(ablation_results)


# ============================================================
# 7. MEAN ± SD SUMMARY
# ============================================================

ablation_summary = (
    ablation_results
    .groupby("model")
    .agg(
        mse_mean=("test_mse", "mean"),
        mse_sd=("test_mse", "std"),

        r2_mean=("test_r2", "mean"),
        r2_sd=("test_r2", "std"),

        pearson_mean=("test_pearson_r", "mean"),
        pearson_sd=("test_pearson_r", "std"),

        mean_best_epoch=("best_epoch", "mean"),

        parameters=("parameters", "first")
    )
    .reset_index()
)


# Order models logically
order = [
    "Full_512-128-512",
    "No_Nonlinearity",
    "Shallow_128",
    "Bottleneck_64",
    "Bottleneck_256",
    "No_Bottleneck"
]

ablation_summary["model"] = pd.Categorical(
    ablation_summary["model"],
    categories=order,
    ordered=True
)

ablation_summary = (
    ablation_summary
    .sort_values("model")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)


print("\n======================================")
print("ABLATION SUMMARY")
print("======================================")

display(ablation_summary)


# ============================================================
# 8. DIFFERENCE RELATIVE TO FULL MODEL
# ============================================================

full_mse = ablation_summary.loc[
    ablation_summary["model"]
    == "Full_512-128-512",
    "mse_mean"
].iloc[0]

full_r = ablation_summary.loc[
    ablation_summary["model"]
    == "Full_512-128-512",
    "pearson_mean"
].iloc[0]


ablation_summary["delta_mse_vs_full"] = (
    ablation_summary["mse_mean"]
    - full_mse
)

ablation_summary["delta_r_vs_full"] = (
    ablation_summary["pearson_mean"]
    - full_r
)


print("\nDifferences relative to Full model:")

display(
    ablation_summary[
        [
            "model",
            "mse_mean",
            "mse_sd",
            "delta_mse_vs_full",
            "pearson_mean",
            "pearson_sd",
            "delta_r_vs_full",
            "parameters"
        ]
    ]
)


# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE
# ============================================================

raw_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "ablation_raw_5seeds.csv"
)

summary_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "ablation_summary_5seeds.csv"
)

ablation_results.to_csv(
    raw_path,
    index=False
)

ablation_summary.to_csv(
    summary_path,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:")
print(raw_path)
print(summary_path)
